records.title: ConLA: Contrastive Latent Action Learning from Human Videos for Robotic Manipulation
records.reason: ConLA learns robotic latent actions from videos to reduce robot demonstration/training burden, not LLM inference cost.

records.title: StereoVLA: Enhancing Vision-Language-Action Models with Stereo Vision
records.reason: StereoVLA adds stereo geometry for robotic manipulation capability/robustness; its subject is embodied policy quality rather than LLM inference.

records.title: CodeDance: A Dynamic Tool-integrated MLLM for Executable Visual Reasoning
records.reason: CodeDance studies executable-code tools for visual reasoning quality/flexibility; it does not present concrete inference-serving improvement.

records.title: T5Gemma 2: Seeing, Reading, and Understanding Longer
records.reason: T5Gemma 2 is an encoder-decoder multimodal model with long-context support and 270M/1B/4B checkpoints, but body focuses on model adaptation and capability benchmarks rather than measured inference memory/latency or a serving optimization.

records.title: Thinking in 360°: Humanoid Visual Search in the Wild
records.reason: The paper studies humanoid visual search control in a physical environment; it is robotics perception/control, not LLM inference systems.
